data.description: GREEN (behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5): Replace mislabel placeholder in tests/drift_injection/inject-and-heal.sh with full end-to-end injection: (a) create Jira issue in DRIFT_TEST_PROJECT_KEY with a corresponding local ticket; (b) overwrite issue's label with a value that does not match the local mapped label; (c) record issue key for EXIT-trap cleanup; (d) assert bridge-fsck non-zero exit BEFORE reconcile_once (DD-2 pre-condition for mislabel class); (e) run python -m dso_reconciler reconcile_once; (f) assert bridge-fsck exit 0 after reconcile_once (DD-3 for mislabel class). Add any needed label-mutation helpers to tests/drift_injection/lib/jira-api.sh. Harness must still skip cleanly when JIRA_API_TOKEN or DRIFT_TEST_PROJECT_KEY absent. ShellCheck must pass.
data.title: Implement mislabel injection subcommand end-to-end
